title: WellnessCafe Pod Task Packet
description: Schema for a single work packet produced by the Work Packet Generator and consumed by execution tools (Cursor, n8n) and QA Sentinel.

packet_id.description: Unique identifier for this packet (e.g. UUID or run-id + sequence).

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when packet was generated.

task_scope.description: What to do; must align with allowed work.

verification.description: Commands and checks QA Sentinel must run.

context_slice.description: Optional subset of steward context relevant to this task (references or excerpts).

approval_required.description: If true, Approval Gate must pause before execution or before marking complete.
